in_sanskrit.name: गज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: He who has the strength and power of an elephant.

in_marathi.name: Gajju
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gajju हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gajju is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘gaja’ which means elephant. In Hindu mythology, the name represents the elephant-headed goddess Ganesha's mother, Parvati. Gajju symbolizes strength, power, and protection.
